sections.heading: What Restaurant Marketing Looks Like in Practice

blocks.text: Effective restaurant marketing combines local search visibility (so you show up when someone searches for "restaurants near me" or your cuisine type), an active social media presence that showcases food quality and atmosphere, and consistent review management that builds trust before a first visit.

items.q: What social platform matters most for restaurants?
items.a: Instagram is typically the highest-performing platform for restaurants due to the visual nature of food content, though Facebook still drives meaningful local reach especially for older demographics. TikTok is increasingly relevant for restaurants looking to reach younger audiences through Reels-format video.

items.q: How important is Google Business Profile for restaurants?
items.a: Extremely — it's often the first thing a potential customer sees when searching for dining options, and photo quality, review rating, and response activity directly influence whether someone chooses your restaurant.
